interpretation: Retrospective descriptive anticipation-of-adaptivity control; not a new opportunity gate or external endpoint.
target: Unchanged uniform fixed 0..100 Brier, including queried numbers.
belief: Unchanged uniform initial unique rule extensions and deterministic membership observations.
committed_control: Choose optimal fixed three-query set without future answer-dependent actions. Equivalent/complement columns deduplicated, constants omitted. Risk-equivalent sorted sets break ties lexicographically. Once resolved, remaining filler queries do not change risk.
receding_control: Optimize a fixed set for remaining budget, execute its smallest query, observe, then replan another fixed set. No anticipated branching, but actual feedback used after every query.
reported_comparisons: h3 versus receding open-loop h3 isolates anticipated adaptivity
h3 versus committed three measures full adaptivity gap
failure_policy: Bank first failure and completed prefix without rerun or cap adjustment.
